main.description: A trail or road (segments/segment-paths), every segment on it the viewer could get from a segment search, never lifts, and the path's sections holding any of them.

sections.description: The path's sections, in its record's order, each with only the returned segments in it; a section holding none is left out. Absent means none.

leaders.description: Each returned segment's leaderboard leader and the viewer's own place on it (segments/segment-leaderboards); a segment with no leaderboard or no entries is left out. Absent means none.

profile.description: The path's terrain profile (segments/path-profile). Absent when none of its line pieces has one.

pathProfile.description: A path's terrain profile, derived by the AppView from terrain tiles as a segment's is (segments/path-profile).

pieces.description: Each line piece the terrain covers, in the path's lines' order; a piece it doesn't cover is left out.

gain.description: Meters the covered pieces climb together.

loss.description: Meters the covered pieces descend together.

spans.description: Where each returned segment lies along a covered piece; a segment along none has no span.

pieceProfile.description: One line piece's smoothed terrain heights, evenly spaced from its start to its end, about 50 m apart.

piece.description: The piece's index in the path view's lines.

heights.description: Heights above sea level in decimeters.

maxGrade.description: The steepest absolute grade along the piece in tenths of a percent, as elevationProfile#maxGrade.

segmentSpan.description: Where a returned segment lies along a covered piece: the first piece, in the lines' order, that both its ends are within 30 m of.

piece.description: The piece's index in the path view's lines.

startMeters.description: How far along the piece the segment's nearer end is.

endMeters.description: How far along the piece its farther end is, at least startMeters.

segmentLeader.description: A returned segment's default leaderboard, all time and everyone, as getSegmentLeaderboard serves it: its type, its first entry and the viewer's own.

board.description: The board type served, as getSegmentLeaderboard's output board.

viewer.description: The signed-in viewer's own entry; absent when they aren't on the board.

sectionView.description: A section of the path (feed.path#section) and the URIs of the returned segments in it.
